stem_book: In the figure shown, the speed of the car is v to the right. The speed with which the block is moving up at θ = 60° is (a) v (b) v/sinθ (c) 3v/4 (d) None of these
work: both string ends on the car: horizontal part lengthens at v, slant part at v cosθ ; block rises at (v + v cos60°)/2 = 3v/4
